1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for plain rubber tubing for general purposes.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provision which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the edition indicated were valid. All standards are subjected to revision, and parties to agreements based on the standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
